claim: A two-mode network with programmable complex coupling and coherent IQ readout can operationally distinguish the orientation-odd seam amplitude from its orientation-blind power square.

platform.preferred: two parametrically coupled microwave resonators with IQ or vector-network-analyser readout
alternatives: programmable photonic interferometer with balanced homodyne
two-mode acoustic network with dual-phase lock-in
platform.control: epsilon=gx+i*gy; seam reversal is a pi pump-phase shift

observables.even: Peven=|Aseam|^2, predicted quadratic in |epsilon| and invariant under reversal

decisionRules: Dodd reverses sign and follows the programmed phase.
Small-amplitude exponents are one for Dodd and two for Peven within uncertainty.
interpretation: Success establishes an operational seam carrier predicted by conventional coherent coupled-mode physics. It is not evidence for a Monster/Leech coupling or four-dimensional gravity without a no-refit source-derived parameter map.
